reviews.text: Excellent service and advice

Hello Daniel Durocher,

Thank you so much for your excellent rating and for your trust. We are delighted to know that you were completely satisfied with your experience at Animalis Paris 16 - Les Belles Feuilles.

We look forward to welcoming you back very soon!

Sincerely,
The Animalis Paris 16 - Les Belles Feuilles Team
A store where you can find many products across all categories.
Amazing
Great team!! They give good advice, they're pleasant and patient 🐈🐈‍⬛ …
Large selection of food products and good advice from always smiling salespeople.

I loved getting to know Animalis. Besides the quantity of excellent quality products, I'd like to highlight Silvia's service. Her energy and friendliness truly made us very happy. We've become customers!
Lots of products and very helpful staff.
Welcoming and friendly staff, always attentive to the customer.
I come here with my cat Hera, and the staff in general are lovely. They give good advice and always remember our last visit. A very friendly atmosphere.
Great welcome, always a pleasure to visit
The staff were attentive and pleasant. The click & collect order was prepared super quickly.
Always well received and well advised.
Excellent store, very attentive and polite staff
Good advice
Thank you so much Bruno and Gibril. 🐯🐯🐯❤️❤️❤️ …

I was very disappointed with my Click & Collect experience.

When I went to pick up my order, one of the products was unavailable. The manager who helped me informed me that a refund would be issued. However, on my account, both items are marked as removed, which is completely inaccurate, and I haven't received any confirmation of the refund.

It seems the system wasn't used correctly, which led to this error. Better computer skills and appropriate training are needed to avoid this type of inconvenience for customers.

It's a shame, because this lack of rigor detracts from the quality of service.

I come here daily with my senior dog, and she prefers coming here to going to the park. It's a very inspiring and stimulating store for animals, but above all, the staff are very warm and friendly! Since the new manager arrived, the store has improved remarkably.

Very good.
Perfect welcome.
Thank you.
Clean store, good welcome and helpfulness from Pauline, whom I thank.

A huge thank you to the sales assistant at Animalis! The sales assistant was incredibly passionate and gave me complete advice about my kitten. I was in such a state of distress; he wasn't eating. They recommended a product, and he finally started eating! The sales assistant was so pleasant and cheerful. Thanks again to both of you; you saved me and my kitten!

We could talk about the uniformity of the store, but it's more accurate to focus on the kindness and care shown to our pet when we visit. My dog ​​has never been happier than when she came to dig for treats and stay in the store to follow her friends "in red." And yet, at first, she wasn't very comfortable in this big store...
She misses you all very much!
Hope to see you again soon...
India, the little Jack Russell!
still as good

If this is indeed Animalia (Google is known for making mistakes in its results!), it's truly a wonderful place for dog lovers, or other animal lovers, I imagine... I dealt with Arnaud a few days ago, and he went out of his way for me. He was also incredibly kind, which was a real pleasure! He was in the middle of a major clean-up of the displays, yet he still made himself available.
So, thank you to him!
The website is outdated; there are no products listed, specifically for aquariums. It would be helpful to update it to avoid unnecessary trips. Thank you.
The sellers were lovely and took the time to help me even in the middle of an order (or delivery or storage). They were very dedicated, thank you!

I often go there to buy toys for my puppy; I always receive good advice and a warm welcome. However, during my last visit two days ago, I had the misfortune of encountering a rat running around the aisles. This makes me question the cleanliness of the place, especially since some treats are self-service and therefore likely come into contact with rodents. I alerted the cashier, who simply ignored me (I should mention that he had no customers to serve). I wasn't the only one who witnessed this, as a little girl was nearby, screaming. Personally, I won't be going back; it's unacceptable to let this kind of thing happen, especially in a grocery store.

I went there with my brother to find a gift for our little sister's cat. We found a magnificent Catbook Pro scratching post, which the cat completely ignores. We're still very happy with this useless but fun purchase. Thanks to the Animalis team.
Excellent service and products, and there are always attractive promotions.
Super nice

I often stop by this shop to do my shopping! What a lovely team! They always ask about my little dog, give great advice, and are very attentive! Thank you for your kindness and the incredible welcome! ✨
Love the attentiveness of the staff 😀 …
Welcome - advice - availability - guidance - Thank you to the team
Professional, friendly...just like Animalis...😊 …

Terrible service... I asked for advice... the salespeople weren't paying attention, they were chatting amongst themselves. I visited the store on August 15, 2025 at 5:30 PM... I was confused about the dog food options for Canishe... the salespeople didn't care... avoid this store... not many choices...🧐🧐🧐🧐🧐 …

Hello Yacine Diaw,

Thank you for your excellent 5-star rating! We are delighted to know that your experience at Animalis Paris 16 - Les Belles Feuilles met your expectations. Your satisfaction is our priority ;-)

Have a lovely day,
The Animalis Paris 16th Team.
Very friendly people and good advice

Hello Jessica,
We are very sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.
We take your one-star rating very seriously and would like to discuss this further with you to find a solution.
Please feel free to contact us at 01.87.76.24.83.
Sincerely,
The Animalis Paris 16th Team
I visited to buy things I needed for my dogs. I bought treats and shampoo, and they were friendly.

Avoid this website!
Every order placed online is canceled after a few days! I tried it three times over the course of a year.

Same problem with Click & Collect. Even with the SMS confirmation, once you arrive, they say, "We don't have your order anymore, it was canceled."

In short... avoid it!
The Animalis store in Les Belles Feuilles has very welcoming staff, and the advice on kibble for my little poodle was very professional. I will definitely be back next time.

I was able to pick up a click and collect order, although the employee was having a little trouble, but a colleague came to help her with a smile – thank you to her! The product was good quality and the price very attractive, convenient for transport, and located in a rather pleasant shopping center.

Absolutely fantastic service! "Tata Bonbon" truly lives up to her nickname; she looked after us like a loving godmother and guided us every step of the way with our first purchases for adopting our puppy, Louki. A huge thank you to her! They have a vast selection of everything you could possibly need, including having your pet tag engraved on-site. 100% recommended!

I went to this store two days ago to buy everything I needed to welcome a kitten. I was a bit overwhelmed with everything I needed to get, and Paul came to the rescue. He was incredibly helpful and exceptionally kind. Thank you to him for his invaluable advice; I'll be back soon to stock up on wet and dry food.
Overall, it's a normal Animalis store, just a little small, and I felt a bit sorry for the poor intern standing around doing nothing. For additional purchases, it does the job perfectly.
Very warm welcome, thank you for the advice
Well organized and well stocked
Good store. Has everything you need. Nice staff!

I go to Animalis very often, and I must say I've rarely experienced such a warm welcome. They love animals and give you the best advice. Jennyfer, the manager, is very attentive and gives my dog ​​little treats every time we visit. I highly recommend them!
Alright
Excellent, well-stocked store, and thank you to the team, especially the lovely manager who helped me carry the cat tree I had just bought. I highly recommend it 😊 …
